items.issue: dot TUI: a status message (L relink, commit, push, pull) is overwritten by the selected file diff when the file list is non-empty, because refresh_status() updates the file lists and their async highlight event re-renders the diff pane after _show_message. Confirmed by a TUI test (non-empty file list, unmocked DiffView, press L): the pane shows the changed.txt diff, not linked <target>. Swapping refresh_status before _show_message does not fix it. Predates PRD 00088 (src/tools/dot/tui/screens/main.py).

items.issue: install_hooks checks the hook is missing then atomic_write_text does os.replace; a hook created in between would be silently replaced (tiny window)
items.reason: cycle 1: microsecond race on the user own hooks dir; exclusive-create would drop the atomic_write invariant

items.finding: capture_index_entry returns None for three distinct states (no index entry, conflicted path with only stages 1/2/3, failed ls-files read) and restore_index_entry(path, None) unconditionally runs cfg rm --cached --ignore-unmatch, so a caller reading None as was-untracked drops conflict stages or a tracked entry whose read merely failed
items.disposition: deferred to task 3 as a tested precondition
items.detail: Raised by Pat in the task-2 per-task review and re-raised as unresolved after the one permitted retry: the fix shipped in task 2 is a docstring contract plus a design-level refusal in check 12, which the reviewer correctly called unenforceable in code. A signature change (enum or result object) was rejected because the committed tests pin is-None for all three states and the Tess dispatch budget for task 2 was exhausted 4/4. The design now REQUIRES task 3 to ship a test that a conflicted or unreadable capture is refused by check 12 and never reaches restore_index_entry(target, None). Verify that test exists before closing task 3.

items.question: Task 3 contract calls hostfilter.count_home(raw_bytes, home) without defining home for CommandShare.
items.assumption: home is the dotfiles root the command was constructed with (str(dotfiles_root)), since dot git work-tree is that root and hostfilter.resolve_home falls back to DOTFILES_ROOT.

items.detail: Design-doc check 10 lists attribute-quoting characters as whitespace, #, !, [ and backslash, which omits the double quote. Git attribute files need a literal double quote escaped too, so a path like .config/say"hi" is accepted by the contract and would be written unquoted. Flagged by Tess during the task 3 adversarial strengthen pass; left unasserted in tests rather than inventing a contract.

Five LOW findings from the task 3 per-task review, left unfixed after the one sanctioned MEDIUM retry (both MEDIUMs were fixed). (1) _roll_back takes the ROLLBACK FAILED branch when only the .gitattributes restore failed, but its message still blames the index entry and sends the user to cfg status / diff --cached; build the index hint only when the index restore failed. (2) the index-mode check moved into _check_after_read, so it runs after read_bytes and after the token/glob/quote checks, while the design contract puts check 12 before check 8 byte read. (3) _QUOTE_CHARS covers only space and tab though the contract says whitespace, so a name with \n, \r, \v or \f would append as two attribute lines (check_attr_filter is the only backstop). (4) the target is not normalized beyond relative_to, so ./foo or a//b appends /./foo filter=dot-host, which never matches, and the user gets a misleading conflicting-attribute error (the share does roll back). (5) _read_attributes never uses self.
